description.narrative: (Haiti): .In its final year of implementation, Project Sante will focus on delivering the main components of the Ministry of Health (MOH) Essential Package of Services (ESP) to reduce morbidity, mortality, and the burden of disease for 4.5 million Haitians. As described in the approved Country Operational Plan (COP) 21, HIV activities will be implemented in community settings through the community health worker (CHW) network to facilitate self-testing, drug distribution, adherence classes and support groups, and samples collection for viral load testing...Maternal health interventions will train health care providers to consistently use referral and counter-referral forms. Working through Mothers' Clubs, these interventions will be used to promote MOH antenatal care recommendations such as encouraging pregnant women to enroll early into the Mothers' Clubs, complete four antenatal visits, and to deliver at a health facility attended by trained health providers. To deliver vaccination and nutrition services to children, Project Sante, together with community members, will use targeted strategies including catch-up vaccination campaigns, which allow a steady coverage from one trimester to the next. To address the reported rise in malnutrition, Project Sante will continue screenings, referrals for treatment, and follow-up at the community level...Projet Sante will also continue to support the provision of modern family planning options and in collaboration with the MOH, will provide integrated supervision and site management to continuously improve facilities' abilities to provide quality services. ..Water and sanitation technical leads will train and retrain site personnel on infection control and prevention and re-activate chlorine distribution for routine disinfection as part of the COVID-19 response...
